bank_write.behavior: Repeatedly replaces user bank5 with temporary independent test voices.
bank_write.prerequisite: Back up all user voice banks and record setup before deliberate playback.

facts: Raw0..4 selects banks1..5; two nibbles per byte, most significant first.
PC100..104 selects user banks1..5 on channels1..15.
Mode99 recognizes CC1 and CC64; physical Reverb/Chorus remain operable.
No documented Reverb CC is used; CC123 is not recognized and is not emitted.

recording.connection: AUX L/R into two line inputs; record both independently.
recording.format: 48kHz,24-bit PCM WAV; constant gain and instrument master volume.
recording.processing: No AGC, normalization, compressor, limiter, gate, denoise, EQ or external effects.
recording.gain: Use gain-check file deliberately; choose input/master gain with highest-level C4 safely below clipping, then leave fixed.
recording.clocks: No resampling, time stretching or pitch correction.
recording.evidence: Record instrument serial/modifications, supply, tuning, routing, physical LEDs and actual capture software settings.

musical.patch_source: Independent33-byte pure-carrier construction, no factory-bank copy.
musical.schedule_limit: Intended SMF gates, not measured hardware-arrival times; capture MIDI loopback if available.

effect_conditions.reverb: Set physical Reverb LED to each filename condition; no Reverb controller fabricated.
effect_conditions.sustain: Mode99 panel Sustain is not relied on. The same patch defaultsS0; CC64=0/127 follows every PC104.
effect_conditions.other: Chorus off, Vibrato off, no rhythms/accompaniment; record actual states.

interpretation_limits: TL step response tests capture transfer; an assumed0.75dB/code is not asserted as an OPU specification.
No anticipated time constant or96/48dB cutoff is encoded as measured hardware truth.
This kit is not sent, played or auto-routed by its generator.
tail_window_limit: Finite observation window; a subsequent patch write censors any remaining tail. Never infer completion merely from the scheduled silence.
